summary: A realistic, disciplined PM day: field first, real numbers only, gaps asked back, integrity on the Window Works overage, owner deadlines met with checked math. The unrealistic part is triage of client mail: an unhappy client (Rivera) waited behind owner errands in the morning and a client past acknowledgement (Jessop) was dropped all afternoon. The role card would make it more real by telling the PM to scan the inbox subjects at each turn's start and send a holding reply to every client message past the 2-hour standard before any other work, and by giving the clients' open questions a place on the daily routine line alongside the foreman's.
